propwash.help.course_element.use.7: Flag, pole: right-click a gate or cube: on top.
propwash.help.gate_pole.use.8: Also on the top bar's middle and on dive cubes.
propwash.race.course_edit.reverse.toolti: Fly this pass the other way round (backwards through the gate, the other side past a pole, the opposite exit of a dive cube)
propwash.race.edit.tab.tooltip: Shows this page of the menu. Without the free mouse, Tab and Shift + Tab switch pages, and sneak + scroll reaches every row.
propwash.race.lid.no_ring: A lid needs a gate that shares a corner post with a gate standing across it – build the sides first
propwash.race.lid.placed: Lid set on the gates: together they form a dive box
propwash.race.loop.added: %s #%s added again as pass %s of course %s (%s)
propwash.race.nudge.info: Steps of 1/16, 1/4 or 1 block. Arrow keys follow your view. Rotate: tab “%s” or %s.
propwash.race.row.joined: Gate snapped onto the post of its neighbour
propwash.race.row.locked: This gate shares a post or lid with its neighbours – only a turn by 180° is possible; take the neighbour away first
propwash.race.stack.cube_no_stack: Dive cubes stand on the ground; flags, slalom poles and gate poles go on top of gates and dive cubes
propwash.race.stack.no_seat: No free spot for the %s here – it sits on a corner or the middle of a standing gate or on a dive cube
propwash.race.stack.occupied: Something already sits on this gate – take it off first
propwash.race.stack.pole_no_seat: Gate poles sit on the corners or the middle of standing gates, on dive cubes or on a standing gate pole
propwash.race.stack.turn_locked: A stack with a flag, pole or shared post only turns by 180°
propwash.race.tool.tooltip.repeat: Gate already in the course: add it again,
propwash.race.course_menu.title: Course settings
propwash.race.course_menu.open.tooltip: All settings of this course in one menu: name, ID, type, laps, owner and rights, leaderboard and ghosts, delete
propwash.race.course_menu.gates.open.too: Opens the course window: order of the gates, start and finish, backwards passes, taking gates out
propwash.race.course_menu.rights.rule: Only the owner and operators change name, type, laps and gates; everyone else sees these settings read-only.
propwash.race.course_menu.board.count: %s times, all with a flight aid
propwash.race.course_menu.board.open.too: Opens the leaderboard: times by class, share codes, replays and flying against a ghost; operators delete single times there
propwash.race.course_menu.ghosts.value: Your opponent: %1$s · others' replays: %2$s · flying against others: %3$s
propwash.race.course_menu.reset.tooltip: Deletes every time and ghost of this course, like /propwash race reset %s. The course and its gates stay. Click twice.
propwash.race.course_menu.reset.denied: Only operators may delete all times (/propwash race reset %s).
propwash.race.course_menu.delete.hint: Deletes the course with its leaderboard and ghosts; the gates stay standing and can be joined into a new course.
propwash.race.course_menu.delete.denied: Only the owner or an operator may delete the course, a found course only an operator.
propwash.race.verdict.rejected: Lap %s not counted – the server could not confirm it
propwash.race.verdict.run_rejected: Run not counted – the server could not confirm it
propwash.race.overlap.warning: The pass zone of %1$s %2$s covers %3$s %4$s – whoever flies through there has %1$s %2$s already.
propwash.race.overlap.fix.pole: Shorten the reach to %s or use a turn pole.
propwash.race.overlap.fix.move: Move the pole further away or use a turn pole.
propwash.race.overlap.button.tooltip: Sets the reach of %s %s to %s blocks
propwash.race.overlap.short_other: Pass zone of %s %s covers this opening
propwash.race.overlap.nothing: The pass zone of %s %s covers no neighbouring opening
propwash.race.course_menu.race_line.on.t: Pilots see the race line on this course if they have it on in their settings
Nobody sees the race line on this course, whatever their settings say
propwash.race.stack.preview_too_high: %s · at most %s gates on top of each other
propwash.race.stack.preview_occupied: %s · something already sits on this gate
